_comment: BANK-NYDFS-HPACK-1 (HELM-HA-BUILD-SPEC.md §3.6): curated, hand-authored chainless packs — the direct-artifact analogue of ha-gate-overlay.json. compile-packs.mjs reads this EVERY run (packs/ is wiped+regenerated wholesale) so these survive a re-compile without hand-placing a file in packs/ (would be deleted on the next compile, per compile-packs.mjs's own writeOut()). Each entry's manifest is schema-validated and workflow_manifest_digest computed the SAME way a chain-derived pack's is — no second canon.

packs.name: NYDFS Part 500 Annual Certification — Countersigned
packs.outcome: Binds the site's NYDFS 23 NYCRR 500 annual Certification of Material Compliance (repo/tools/570-nydfs-part500-certification-builder.html — a chainless browser tool, no OCG kernel) to a §27.3 maker-checker countersignature_slot via the §3.1 attested-artifact binding path: the CISO/compliance maker signs the exact certification bundle produced, a checker performs the §3.3 Tier-B binding-integrity verification (digests recompute, NOT a re-run of the tool), and the senior-officer acceptance node holds under dual_control(2) until two distinct identities have recorded — the annual Apr 15 certification's countersignature_slot showcase.

packs.name: Delegated Authority Bordereau Recomputation
packs.outcome: Recomputes a delegated authority bordereau the way the carrier reviewer does, from the same file the coverholder sent: footing per currency, authority-limit utilisation, and population-integrity checks. Single-node chainless pack — HELMCHECK-BUILD-1's `helm check` pack for this kernel; no chain exists for a standalone node.

packs.name: Securitisation Payment Waterfall Recomputation
packs.outcome: Recomputes a securitisation payment waterfall for one stated period from the available funds and the caller-declared priority ladder, so an investor can check it against the Article 7 investor report locally without uploading it. Single-node chainless pack — SECZ-PACK-1's `helm check` pack for this kernel; no chain exists for a standalone node.

packs.name: Article 5 Due-Diligence Evidence Record
packs.outcome: Records, per position and period, which Article 5 verification and ongoing-monitoring duties an investor performed, the evidence behind each, and what remains outstanding as a named gap list. Single-node chainless pack — no chain exists for a standalone node. This kernel has no asserted-vs-recomputed comparison surface (it assembles an evidence record; it does not recompute a figure against a report), so it is registered for pack resolution and the shared kernel-runner execution path but is not wired into `helm check`'s CHECK_ADAPTERS — see SECZ-PACK-1's check-off note.

packs.name: CCP Default Waterfall Recompute to Cover-2 Sizing
packs.outcome: Recomputes a CCP's sequential default-waterfall loss allocation for a caller-declared defaulting-member loss, then checks whether the recomputed allocation stays within the CCP's Cover-2 default fund sizing or breaches it. CCPCORE-HELM-1 (CCP-CORE-BUILD-SPEC.md §4): the curated treasury-clearing-domain sibling pack for chain-ccp-default-waterfall, alongside that chain's own auto-compiled pack-chain-ccp-default-waterfall — registered here (not auto-compiled under this name) because the source chain is named chain-ccp-default-waterfall, not treasury-clearing-default-waterfall.

packs.name: Cross-CCP PQD Benchmark
packs.outcome: Single-node cross-CCP public quantitative disclosure (PQD) benchmark: compares a caller-selected set of CPMI-IOSCO PQD fields across FICC and ICE using a source-cited fixture dataset, flagging any caller-declared threshold breach per entity. CCPCORE-HELM-1 (CCP-CORE-BUILD-SPEC.md §4): the curated treasury-clearing-domain sibling pack for chain-ccp-pqd-benchmark, alongside that chain's own auto-compiled pack-chain-ccp-pqd-benchmark.

packs.name: Member Margin Call Lifecycle to Client Porting Check
packs.outcome: Attests a clearing member's margin call lifecycle against its SLA window; an unmet-SLA call (disputed, escalated, or still-open past the SLA) routes to the client porting check as a contingency path, while a funded within-SLA call ends. CCPCORE-HELM-1 (CCP-CORE-BUILD-SPEC.md §4): the curated treasury-clearing-domain sibling pack for chain-member-margin-call-to-porting, alongside that chain's own auto-compiled pack-chain-member-margin-call-to-porting. The source chain's gate (unmet-SLA -> porting check) is a run-time routing decision inside art-531's own kernel output, not a manifest-level gate node, so this sibling's manifest carries the same two-node linear shape as the auto-compiled pack.
